proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width strip immediately after main content and before the cookie overlay, containing an identical tagline ("The best no-code platform for ...") plus a row of partner-logo placeholders (rendered as bare "| |" text), appearing on every page with identical content.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a global footer/CTA fragment excluded from per-page block inventory, mirroring the announcement bar and cookie overlay chrome. Alternative rejected: a per-page 'logo-strip' block via repeating-cards-are-one-block, since content is identical across every page, not page-specific.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text and structure recur unchanged across all sampled pages; it is site-wide chrome, not authorable page content.

provenance.evidence: C149 rc3c1c1/rc3c1c2 identical across C147-C154 packets

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] answer node appears a second time as a top-level page sibling (outside the FAQ accordion container) with text duplicating an answer already nested inside the accordion.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude the duplicate top-level region from the block inventory; content already captured inside the faq-accordion block's nested rows.
proposed_rules.rationale: Absolute-positioned/expanded accordion answer panels get promoted out of their DOM parent by the capture tool, producing duplicate top-level nodes that are a capture artifact.

provenance.evidence: C149 rc4 'Teams use Knack Health to buil...' also present nested under rc2c9c2
